# Notebook Source QA

Notebook Source QA imports source packs, URLs, versions, customer projects, and forbidden sources, then tracks freshness, conflicts, missing documents, and client reports.

Website: https://notebooksourceqa.space/
Docs pattern reference: https://github.com/clauxel/MiroFish
Primary keyword: NotebookLM source pack QA
Type: SaaS
Default plan: Team

Public boundary: docs-only repository; no production source code or secrets.
